product.trigem-sx386m.summary: TriGem OEM motherboard with a 16 MHz 80386SX, Headland chipset, IDE and six ISA slots.
product.trigem-sx386m.history: TriGem built this SX386M board, revision KS-II, for other companies' computers, such as the Emerson Elite SX386/16 and the CMS Enhancements ESP SX386M. It is not an Olivetti model or a rebadged Olivetti. Epson's guide to the 20 MHz version describes another TriGem revision.
product.trigem-sx386m.warning: EXPERIMENTAL: POST with 4 MB, CMOS configuration and MS-DOS 6.22 boot are validated. The 8 MHz low-speed mode is implemented as an approximation and untested. All RAM populations, shadow, EMS and parity/NMI still need validation; the exact peripheral chips and the keyboard-controller ROM are unknown.
product.trigem-sx386m.technical.cpu_bus: Intel 80386SX at 16 MHz with documented 8 MHz low-speed mode; optional 80387SX.
product.trigem-sx386m.technical.memory: Parity DRAM: documented populations of 512/640 KB and 1/1.5/2/3/4/4.5/5/6/8 MB. The BIOS encodes the bank configuration in the HT113 and BluMach uses the same encoding for all of them. Without shadow, the 384 KB of the hole becomes extended memory; Setup subtracts it when shadow is enabled.
product.trigem-sx386m.technical.chipset: Photographs identify the Headland HT101SX, HT113 and GC102-PC. BluMach using the same chipset model as for the Olivetti PCS 386SX does not link this board to Olivetti.
product.trigem-sx386m.technical.expansio: Four 16-bit and two 8-bit ISA slots; external video adapter.
product.trigem-sx386m.technical.rom_layo: One 64 KB linear image at F0000h, expected as EESX386.BIN; metadata only, not redistributed.
product.trigem-sx386m.technical.headland: The BIOS probes the HT113 at 1ECh–1EFh, clears 64 registers and programs CR0–CR4, including CR2=DAh; it does not use 92h. BIOS shadow is CR0 bit 4. Video shadow copies C0000h-C7FFFh to RAM and keeps it mapped through EMS page registers 24 and 25, write-protected.
product.trigem-sx386m.technical.jumpers: J2 enables 80387SX; JP4 selects LPT1/LPT2; JP6 selects mono/color; RAM follows documented SIMM populations.
product.trigem-sx386m.technical.io: Integrated IDE, floppy, two serial ports, parallel port and AT keyboard. The 3F3h latch used by the BIOS delays COM and LPT activation; the exact controller ICs are still being researched.
product.trigem-sx386m.technical.video: Video is provided by an external ISA adapter; the motherboard has no integrated VGA or video firmware.
product.trigem-sx386m.technical.verified: Authentic AMI firmware identifies Emerson, completes 4096 KB POST, detects COM1/COM2/LPT without false conflicts, and installs then boots MS-DOS 6.22 from a 40 MB type 17 IDE disk.
product.trigem-sx386m.technical.limitati: Experimental. All RAM populations, System+Video shadow, parity/NMI, low-speed mode and EMS still need validation. Low-speed mode follows bits 2-3 of the keyboard-controller output port (Ctrl+Alt+grey − and grey +, and Start-up Speed in Setup), but is approximated with memory wait states without changing the CPU clock. Exact peripheral ICs are unidentified, so AT-compatible approximations are used. The memory selector still allows undocumented 128 KB intermediate values.
product.trigem-sx386m.technical.manual: Micro House two-page reference for the CMS Enhancements ESP SX386M board; link and metadata only.
product.trigem-sx386m.technical.vogons: Emerson Elite SX386/16 preservation thread with photographs, FCC identity, AMI BIOS and 80387SX jumper test.
product.trigem-sx386m.technical.epson_ca: The Epson SX386M guide describes a different 20 MHz revision with cache and up to 32 MB.
